when: Three to five peer sections at the top level of the app
rules: Each tab has an icon and a text label and the bar stays visible on root screens; every tab remembers its own stack and scroll position; tapping the active tab returns to the top; the cart tab carries a count badge
avoid: Six or more tabs; icon-only tabs; a tab that opens a modal instead of a section

when: Root list screens
rules: Large title collapses to inline on scroll; pushed detail screens use inline title and back
avoid: Large titles on detail screens; custom headers that fight the system collapse

when: Every pushed screen
rules: Never block the back gesture; make it interactive so a partial swipe cancels; support Android predictive back
avoid: Custom full-width pan gestures that steal the edge; disabling back without a discard confirm

when: Secondary tasks that should keep the parent screen in view, such as filters, option pickers, sharing and quick actions
rules: Show a grabber and settle at defined detents over a dimmed scrim; the user can close it by dragging down or with an explicit button; inner content scrolls only once the sheet is fully expanded
avoid: A sheet opened from another sheet; no visible close button; sheet drag competing with inner scroll

when: Multi-step tasks such as login or checkout
rules: Close control top-left; show progress; confirm before discarding entered data
avoid: Using a modal for browsing; no way out mid-task

when: 2-3 contextual choices on an item
rules: Offer 2-3 choices plus Cancel and avoid more than four buttons including Cancel; mark the destructive choice as destructive; keep Cancel separate on iOS; long-press opens a context menu with a preview
avoid: More than four buttons including Cancel; making long-press the only route to an action

when: Irreversible or blocking decisions only
rules: Specific verb button labels; destructive option marked; at most two or three buttons
avoid: Alerts for success messages; vague OK or Cancel labels

when: Catalogue larger than a few dozen items
rules: Tap on field opens full search; recent searches; suggestions while typing; clear button; filters after results
avoid: Keeping a tiny inline field that filters in place; empty results with no suggestion

when: Product lists with several facets
rules: Bottom sheet; quick-filter chips outside; live result count on the apply button; reset; persist the choice on return
avoid: Applying on every tap with reflow flicker; full-page filter screens; apply button without a count

when: Browsing a category or search results
rules: Two columns; fixed image ratio such as 4:5; name max two lines; price with tabular figures; consistent gutters; more columns on tablets
avoid: Mixed image ratios causing jagged rows; hiding price until tap

when: Each item in a grid or list
rules: Image, name, price, rating and a colour hint; favourite heart as a 44pt target; sale price with the original struck through
avoid: Tiny heart targets; cards without a price; text over busy images without a scrim

when: Product detail page
rules: Full-bleed swipeable hero; page dots; pinch zoom; tap for fullscreen; first-class video for texture or drape
avoid: Tiny thumbnails only; zoom that fights the page swipe

when: Choosing colour, size or other options on the product page
rules: Make each swatch a 44pt touch target and print the chosen option name beside the swatches; mark the choice with a ring and a check so colour is not the only cue; keep sold-out options visible with a strike-through and a notify-me action; swap the hero image to match; move to a sheet when options are many
avoid: Marking selection by colour alone; removing or disabling sold-out options without a reason; swatches smaller than the touch target

when: Product detail page once the main CTA scrolls out of view
rules: Pinned above the safe area and above the keyboard; shows price and the CTA; full-width or CTA with quantity; reflects the selected variant
avoid: Covering content with no bottom inset; a second competing CTA

when: Reviewing the cart after add-to-cart or from the bag icon
rules: Editable quantity stepper; remove with undo; sticky subtotal and checkout button; promo code collapsed; edit without leaving the sheet
avoid: Forcing a full page load to change quantity; hiding shipping cost until the last step

when: Cart or cart sheet when a free-shipping threshold exists
rules: Progress bar plus a sentence with the remaining amount in VND; celebrate once when reached; threshold shown as real money; progress uses the same number as the website (for example subtotal before discount) and the copy says which
avoid: Confetti loops; thresholds that change silently; colour-only progress

when: Product detail pushed above the tabs, so the tab bar and its bag icon are not on screen
rules: Toast or small sheet right after the add, with a View bag action that opens the bag tab; name the product and variant; badge bumps and the item flies only if the bag icon is visible; auto-dismiss after about 4s unless the screen reader is on
avoid: Silent add with no way to reach the bag; a blocking alert; a toast that covers the sticky buy bar

when: Purchase flow
rules: Guest checkout first; address autofill; correct keyboard types; inline validation; local payments COD, MoMo, ZaloPay, VietQR, plus Apple Pay or Google Pay; no surprises in the total; pinned pay button
avoid: Forced account creation; new fees on the last step; clearing the form on error

when: Discounted products and voucher codes
rules: Current price prominent; original struck through; savings stated in VND; animate only a real change; voucher field collapsed with a clear error message
avoid: Fake urgency timers; unreadable strikethrough contrast; price jumping without cause

when: Vietnam shops where buyers prefer paying at handover
rules: Offer as a visible option; show the amount to prepare in VND; confirm phone and address on a final review; tell the user a delivery call or message may follow; make cancel before dispatch easy
avoid: Hiding COD behind other methods; asking card details for COD; no order confirmation screen

when: Vietnam buyers paying with the MoMo wallet
rules: Label the button with the MoMo name; before leaving, show a short note that MoMo will open; on return show a pending state until the order status is confirmed, then success or failure with a retry; support the app not being installed with a fallback method
avoid: Treating return from the wallet as proof of payment; losing the cart on return; dead end when the app is missing

when: Vietnam buyers paying with ZaloPay or Zalo
rules: The merchant app opens ZaloPay or Zalo, and after payment that app reopens the merchant app to show the result; if neither app is installed the user is sent to the store, so offer other methods too; show a pending state on return and confirm the status before success; keep the cart intact
avoid: Assuming return equals paid; no fallback when the app is absent; clearing the cart before the result

when: Vietnam buyers paying by scanning a QR in any banking app
rules: QR carries the exact amount and the transfer content (noi dung chuyen khoan) with the order reference so the payment can be matched; keep that reference short and plain (50 characters or fewer and no special characters); show amount, bank, account and reference as copyable text too; let the user save the QR image; show waiting state with an expiry and update when paid
avoid: Free-typed amounts; reference that the user must retype; QR that cannot be saved or copied; no waiting state

when: Shops that close sales through Zalo or Messenger chat
rules: Product share from the app pre-fills a chat message with name, variant, price and link; show an order summary card inside the app after the chat; keep an in-app order status
avoid: Dead-end deep links when the chat app is missing; losing the selected variant when handing off

when: After purchase
rules: Vertical timeline with current step emphasised; estimated delivery date; contact and support action; push notification deep links to this screen
avoid: Hiding status behind email only; tracking numbers with no explanation

when: Product detail page
rules: Rating summary and photo strip near the top; sort by helpful; full list in a sheet
avoid: Burying reviews at the bottom of a long page; star rating without a count

when: Saving products for later
rules: Heart toggles optimistically with haptic; sync across devices; badge or list updates immediately; undo on removal
avoid: Requiring login for the first tap without saving intent; no way to see the list

when: Feeds and order lists backed by remote data
rules: Use the system control; refresh only data lists; keep content visible while refreshing
avoid: Custom spinners on static screens; pull refresh on screens with horizontal paging

when: Cart, wishlist, order and message rows
rules: At most two actions; destructive on the trailing edge; undo after delete; provide an accessible alternative such as a menu
avoid: Swipe as the only way to delete; many actions behind a swipe

when: User-ordered lists
rules: Long-press to lift with haptic; neighbours make room; visible handle for accessibility
avoid: Reorder with no handle or alternative; no feedback on lift

when: Product, cart and form screens built around a single main action
rules: Dock the button at the bottom inside the safe area at 52-56pt tall; put the price beside it when money is involved; lift it with the keyboard instead of hiding behind it
avoid: Floating over content without extra bottom padding; more than one primary button

when: Any screen on a tall phone
rules: Primary actions in the lower half; destructive or rare actions away from easy reach; respect safe areas
avoid: Primary button at the top; content under the home indicator

when: Any input flow
rules: Label above the field; correct keyboard type and return key; advance to the next field; scroll the focused field above the keyboard; tall fields with 52pt height
avoid: Placeholder-only labels; wrong keyboards; validating only on submit

when: Phone verification and login
rules: Number keyboard; autofill from SMS where the platform supports it; auto-advance and paste; resend with visible countdown
avoid: Separate tiny boxes with no paste; hidden resend

when: Lists and screens waiting on data
rules: Skeleton matching the final layout; spinner only for short button actions; keep cached content visible
avoid: Full-screen spinners; skeletons that differ in layout from the content

when: Cart, wishlist, search results or order history with nothing in it
rules: Say in one short line why it is empty and offer exactly one next step; a small illustration is optional
avoid: A blank screen; several equal-weight buttons

when: Network failure
rules: Inline retry; keep cached content; say what happened in plain language
avoid: Blank screen; error codes only; blocking alert for every failure

when: Non-critical feedback after an action
rules: Short duration; above the tab bar; one at a time; undo where the action is reversible; Snackbar on Android
avoid: Toasts for errors that need action; stacked toasts

when: First launch
rules: One to three screens; skippable; sell value not features
avoid: Long carousels; asking for all permissions up front

when: Notifications, camera, location
rules: Explain value in context before the system prompt; ask at the moment of need; handle denial with a settings path
avoid: Asking on first launch; repeated prompts after denial

when: Global feedback layer
rules: One wrapper with three kinds: selection, impact and notification; throttle; respect the system setting
avoid: Haptics on scroll; haptic on every tap

when: Switching between a few views of the same content
rules: Keep to about five segments or fewer on iPhone; equal-width segments; animated selection; short labels
avoid: Using it for navigation between unrelated screens; more than about five segments on iPhone

when: One dominant create action on Android
rules: Extend with label at rest and collapse on scroll; keep clear of bottom navigation
avoid: Several FABs; FAB covering content actions

when: Always
rules: Semantic colour tokens; elevation shown by lighter surfaces; images slightly dimmed
avoid: Simply inverting colours; relying on shadows for depth

when: Always
rules: Text scales with system settings; labels on icon buttons; 4.5:1 contrast; every animation has a reduced-motion fallback
avoid: Fixed font sizes; gesture-only actions

when: Product and order pages
rules: Universal and app links open the exact screen; share sheet includes product image and title
avoid: Links that open the home screen only
